retrievalProfile.description: A radial collage featuring four figures standing on a central textured sphere against a fragmented blue background.
triggerTerms: figures standing on a small planet
excludeWhen: a clean minimalist layout is required
a single focal point without radial elements is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a central, earthy-textured sphere. Four distinct human figures are positioned at 90-degree intervals around the sphere, appearing to stand on its surface. The background consists of overlapping, rectangular fragments of light blue paper, creating a mosaic effect. Each figure holds a small yellow rectangular sign with black text. The central text is horizontally aligned across the sphere.
coreVisualRelationships: Radial symmetry of figures around a central anchor
Contrast between the warm, earthy sphere and the cool, fragmented blue background
Repetition of yellow rectangular signs held by each figure
Textural contrast between photographic cutouts and paper-mosaic background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large textured sphere occupies the center; four figures are scaled to appear as if standing on its circumference, oriented towards the four cardinal directions.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the central sphere and moves outward along the four figures in a circular motion, following the radial symmetry.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The fragmented blue background provides active negative space that supports the central cluster.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, medium saturation blue background contrasts with the low value, high texture brown center.

letterConstructionRules: Lowercase letters for the main title
Heavy slab serifs with rounded terminals
Integration of a spiral or 'at' symbol within the letter 'o'
Uppercase, blocky sans-serif for the peripheral signs
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'o' is replaced or modified with a concentric spiral graphic.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold slab serif for the main title paired with heavy condensed sans-serif for secondary labels.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif structure and rounded feel.
Suitable for the heavy, condensed uppercase text on the signs.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a collage background using overlapping rectangular fragments of light blue paper. In the center, place a large, circular sphere with a rough, earthy, brown-and-tan texture. Position four photographic cutouts of people standing on the sphere at 90-degree intervals (top, bottom, left, right), each holding a small yellow rectangular sign.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a white slab-serif font across the center of the sphere, replacing the 'o' with a spiral symbol. Add black uppercase condensed sans-serif text onto each of the four yellow signs, rotating the text to match the orientation of each sign.

verificationChecks: Is the background composed of visible blue paper fragments?
Are there four figures oriented radially around the center?
Is the central text white and slab-serif?
Does the 'o' in the central text feature a spiral design?

adjustableVariables: Number of figures around the sphere
Content of the text on the signs
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the radial symmetry is maintained.
Verify the background has a fragmented, tiled appearance.
Check that the text on the signs is oriented correctly relative to the figures.
Confirm the central sphere has a distinct earthy texture.
recipe.reuseFormula: Radial collage + central textured anchor + fragmented mosaic background + peripheral signage.
